mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the gist of criminal proceedings and as Justice Stephen Brown has noted:" it is to a trial what the bullet is to a gun"."
The sentence is the gist of criminal proceedings and as Justice Stephen Brown has noted:" it is to a trial what the bullet is to a gun".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a "contract" whereby an accused person is delivered to a surety or also the "contract" of the surety him/her self."
Kenny says that bail is a "contract" whereby an accused person is delivered to a surety or also the "contract" of the surety him/her self.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for the execution of the judgements of the courts."
The Sheriff is responsible for the execution of the judgements of the courts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a partial defence at common law and under the Criminal Code and the customary law."
Intoxication is a partial defence at common law and under the Criminal Code and the customary law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the dominant religion in the Northern states of Nigeria, (the Middle belt area and Tivland, excempted)."
Islam is the dominant religion in the Northern states of Nigeria, (the Middle belt area and Tivland, excempted).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the chief law officer of Government."
The Attorney-General is the chief law officer of Government.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a matter of the Law of Tort."
The rest is a matter of the Law of Tort.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Caliph, the Sultan of Sokoto."
The head of the Islamic Caliphate is the Caliph, the Sultan of Sokoto.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for the crimes he commits."
An offending police officer is responsible for the crimes he commits.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a decision in the tort of deceit and to that extent is limited."
Note that Derry v Peek is a decision in the tort of deceit and to that extent is limited.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the Supreme Court of Nigeria, the Court of Appeal, the Federal High Court, the Customary Courts of Appeal and the Sharia Court of Appeal of the Federal Capital Territory."
The Federal courts are the Supreme Court of Nigeria, the Court of Appeal, the Federal High Court, the Customary Courts of Appeal and the Sharia Court of Appeal of the Federal Capital Territory.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an exception to this general rule."
The Federal High Court is an exception to this general rule.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person who has undertaken responsibility in the amount fixed for the accused to answer his bail."
A surety is a person who has undertaken responsibility in the amount fixed for the accused to answer his bail.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a temple of justice and the Bench or Inner Bar (magistrates and judges) as well as the Outer Bar (legal practitioners) are ministers in that temple of justice."
The court is a temple of justice and the Bench or Inner Bar (magistrates and judges) as well as the Outer Bar (legal practitioners) are ministers in that temple of justice.
